record.excerpt: Bitcoin tends to have bad Sundays, so this strategy just sells on Saturday, and buys back the next Wednesday if the price is kinda going up! … (The strategy works best if you set your chart time period to 1 day.)
record.notes: Day-of-week rule (exit Saturday, re-enter Wednesday); re-entry condition "kinda going up" is fuzzy, compiler must flag it.
